sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and an impressive recent run of five consecutive wins (plus one draw), host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Alsager are bottom of the division with just 4 points and winless in their last five matches, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their unbeaten streak.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a potential title-race fixture, with Stafford looking to close the two-point gap on leaders Sandbach despite their most recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth, third and unbeaten in five, face a tough home test against mid-table Eccleshall. Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a clash between fourth and ninth, with both sides showing inconsistent recent form. Foley Meir entertain Bilston Town in a meeting of teams separated by just one point in mid-table. Market Drayton Town, struggling with three losses in their last five, travel to face struggling Crewe. Cheadle Heath Nomads, second-bottom with just one win all season, travel to Telford Town who are also in dire form with just one win from nine games. Brereton Social, mid-table and inconsistent, host winless Widnes Town at the foot of the league. Shawbury United, one of the division's poorest performers with only one win in nine games, host Barnton who are mid-table and unbeaten in their last two. Finally, Allscott Heath travel to face Crewe in what should be a competitive mid-to-lower-table encounter.
